issues.problem: cl-gasuru contrast をする: said 匂いをする is wrong but did not mention the real 〜をしている pattern for visible features (青い目をしている), which learners meet and may overgeneralise.
issues.action: Added a short note on 〜をしている for appearance.

issues.problem: cl-adj explain: 'Exercise is 激しい, not 強い or 重い' left out the very common 軽い運動 (light exercise), and 強い運動 does occur.
issues.action: Rewrote as 'Hard exercise is 激しい (light exercise is 軽い運動), never 重い.'

issues.problem: cl-adj mistake: 強いコーヒー is in real use (strong roast or caffeine), so the 'bad' sentence was not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Changed the mistake to 強いお茶 → 濃いお茶, the clear English calque and a member of the skill's set.

issues.problem: cl-adj contrast 濃い vs 強い: said '強いコーヒー sounds foreign', which matched the dropped mistake and overstated the case.
issues.action: Changed to '強いお茶 is an English calque.'

issues.problem: Contrast for する said 'Only for sports, accessories and noun + する', which contradicts the guide's own がする step and leaves out 電話をする, which the guide calls fine elsewhere.
issues.action: Changed it to cover する after を (with 電話をする) and to point to が + する for perceptions.
